loinc_label: HIV 2 Ab [Presence] in Serum
claim: This test is a test used in diagnosing the disease "AIDS".
context: diagnosis: Confirm HIV Infection and Differentiate HIV-1 from HIV-2 — AIDS classification first requires established HIV infection. Contemporary multitest algorithms include differentiation of HIV-1 and HIV-2. In the U.S. laboratory testing algorithm, specimens are screened with an HIV-1/2 antigen/antibody (fourth-generation) immunoassay; a reactive screen reflexes to an HIV-1/HIV-2 antibody differentiation immunoassay, and a negative or indeterminate differentiation result is resolved with an HIV-1 nucleic acid amplification test, the step that identifies acute HIV-1 infection.
